description: This file is a shell script setting up tests for a Git filter framework. It includes functions, configuration setups, and various test cases to verify behavior of filters such as delay, rot13 encoding, error handling, and process control during Git operations.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: A function that writes a script to a specified file; used here to generate a rot13 transformer script embedded within the tests.

methods.name: generate_random_characters
methods.description: Generates a file with random lowercase characters of specified length using an external tool.

methods.name: filter_git
methods.description: A wrapper to run git commands with a cleaned-up environment, primarily to invoke git with specific filters.
